world.title: Switchback Station
world.author: Lantern Trails
world.description: Parcel junctions read what Pip carries. Refill loops, wrong-colour branches and counting platforms build a station of your own.
world.intro: The finale: four colours, seven decision stations, repeated deliveries and a bell duet. Hold both jade plates using the crate and yourself. Amber, jade and violet need two parcels each; blue needs three. Release your jade plate after amber is full so jade’s counting stamp can read Quiet. Pip rings first; you answer Home.
world.ending: Every window shines. Pip leaves its three cards beside your blank map. The station can send parcels along a road, but only a builder can decide where a new adventure begins.
world.hint: Go north, east four, south, west twice to hold jade with the crate. Apply East / East / Use. Run 45 turns and pause; step north off jade so the counting stamp can read Quiet. Run 183 more turns and pause. Step south, then east four and ring Home. Fetch the far light, then return around the crate by the upper row. Finish at the beacon.
